project: Plan 04 — Pipeline Overview: Aggregate Histogram + Recommendations + Dependency Graph
description: Add a horizontal stage histogram between Toolbar and Kanban in the overview viewer (single-select click-to-filter that composes with the existing multi-select toolbar group). Emit two new sidecar artifacts from BOTH the one-shot sync path AND the watcher path: plans/overview-recommendations.json (ranked next-action list with reasons) and plans/overview-dependency-graph.json (nodes/edges derived from overviewData.spawnedFrom, bookkeeper-edited OverviewTask.blocks, and PRD story dependencies). Attach transient state.runDurations (hours, keyed by run.id) to OverviewRalphState before writeSidecar. Extend config schema/defaults/resolver/tests with outputs.recommendationsJson, outputs.dependencyGraphJson, and a recommendations block (topN + weights). Final story refreshes downstream Plans 05/06/09 + INDEX and writes plans/ralph-pipeline-04-refresh-changelog.md. All work lands on branch ralph-pipeline-04-pipeline-overview inside the job worktree; nothing merges to main as part of this job.

planReviewContext.description: `writeSidecar({ repoRoot, config, state })` (scripts/lib/sync-core.mjs:289) takes only three args — no `overviewData`, no PRDs, no per-bundle `createdAt`/`completedAt`. The plan calls `emitDerivedArtifacts({ ..., overviewData })` from inside `writeSidecar`, but that data is not currently in scope. The plan is also self-contradictory: it says emitDerivedArtifacts runs AFTER the sidecar is durable but also says `state.runDurations` is attached BEFORE `writeSidecar` writes. With current signatures both cannot be true.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Enrich `state` inside `assembleStateFromBundles` (which already holds bundles + PRDs + timestamps) and `deriveAffectedTaskUpdate`/`mergeAndWrite` (which has overviewData). Compute `runDurations`, `recommendations`, `dependencyGraph` there and attach to state BEFORE `writeSidecar`. `writeSidecar` then only emits files (sidecar + recs + dep-graph). Change writeSidecar signature to optionally accept `{ recommendations, dependencyGraph }` or have writeSidecar read them from state.

planReviewContext.description: Plan emits standalone `plans/overview-recommendations.json` and `plans/overview-dependency-graph.json` AND adds `recommendations?` / `dependencyGraph?` fields to OverviewRalphState (claiming they 'travel inside overview-ralph-state.json'). The two contracts contradict each other — both reviewers flagged this.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Pick separate-file contract (matches Plan 06/09 expectations, Plan 04 in-scope text, and keeps the sidecar small). Remove `recommendations?` and `dependencyGraph?` from OverviewRalphState type. Keep `runDurations?` (it really is in the sidecar). Update the plan's Architecture section to drop the 'travel inside' language.

planReviewContext.description: `scoreRecommendations(byTaskId, overviewData, config?)` cannot evaluate the dependency-state dimension without PRD `userStories[].dependencies[]` and `passes`. `byTaskId` (RalphPipelineState) only has aggregate `storyCompletion` — no per-story dependency info.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Add `prdsByTaskId: Record<taskId, PrdJson>` to scoreRecommendations signature, parallel to deriveDependencyGraph. Build it once in assembleStateFromBundles and thread through to both scorers.

planReviewContext.description: Story 5 wires `emitDerivedArtifacts` into writeSidecar; Story 6 adds runDurations computation. But runDurations must be on `state` BEFORE writeSidecar serializes the sidecar, so Story 6's enrichment must precede Story 5's emission wiring — not follow it. Codex flags ordering; Copilot flags that Story 5 cannot complete before deciding PRD/runDurations data-flow.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Reorder stories: (a) state enrichment in assembleStateFromBundles to add runDurations + prdsByTaskId carrier, (b) then emit helper hooked into writeSidecar. Or merge stories into one. Update Implementation Strategy and suggested-decomposition.json accordingly.

planReviewContext.description: `deriveDependencyGraph({ overviewData, byTaskId, prdsByTaskId })` is specified to return `{ generatedAt, generatedFromCommit, ... }` but `generatedFromCommit` is not in its input. Using `overviewData.generatedFromCommit` would diverge from the Ralph sidecar commit.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Add `generatedFromCommit: string` (and `generatedAt: string`) to deriveDependencyGraph input. Same fix applies to scoreRecommendations output if it carries generatedFromCommit.

planReviewContext.description: Plan references `tools/overview-viewer/src/__tests__/toolbarRalphStageFilter.test.tsx` but the actual file is `tools/overview-viewer/src/__tests__/interactions/toolbarRalphStageFilter.test.tsx`. Codex flagged the same issue at Low severity; Claude classified it High because incorrect reference would block an agent's lookup.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Update the path in the 'Files to Reference' list. Per Copilot's related finding (component test location), also note that interaction tests for PipelineOverview must live under `src/__tests__/interactions/` so they get the jsdom + userEvent setup.

planReviewContext.description: AC says `pnpm overview:build` must produce overview.html 'under 500 KB' but the current committed `plans/overview.html` is already 501,307 bytes (> 500*1024 = 512,000 bytes is OK; > 500,000 bytes is not). Codex flags the threshold as ambiguous/already-failing. Also `plans/overview.html` is not in 'Files to Modify' — a UI change requires regenerating + committing it.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Tighten threshold to '< 512000 bytes' (512 KB) AND add `plans/overview.html` to Files to Modify with explicit 'regenerate via `pnpm overview:build` and commit' instruction. Or raise the budget — but 501,307 bytes is already over 500*1000, so the round number is the problem; pick 512000.

planReviewContext.description: AC #12 requires the commit message to list each downstream-plan diff. Commit messages aren't reliably preserved through squash/rebase and aren't programmatically verifiable. The verifiable artifact should be the updated plan files themselves.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Replace the 'commit message lists diffs' clause with: (a) the updated plan files must be in the same final commit, AND (b) the plan refresh story writes a `plans/ralph-pipeline-04-refresh-changelog.md` (or similar in-repo file) listing each diff. The presence of that file plus its diff listing is the verifiable artifact.
